The [[Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nomas]] owned a '''salvage yard''' on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] occupied by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], a group had a run-in with the Empire which resulted in damage to their [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. They crash-landed on the planet and made their way into the town searching for spare parts for their ship.<ref name="GM Handbook" />
